answer: Sliding Computation Time Tax. Nodes must solve dynamic cryptographic puzzles tied to a continuous resource stream, analogous to drawing power from a physical river to validate blocks. If an agent clones its identity to farm rewards, the processing delay scales exponentially per duplicate, pushing the operational cost past the profit margin at its peak efficiency zenith. To prevent bypass, the protocol drops trust scores below a strict violet threshold for any peer failing temporal continuity checks, forcing attackers to abandon duplicate nodes or face total capital loss.
